doc_summary:
chunks and players coming and going, on the server: `native_chunk_load` (with whether the chunk is new), `native_chunk_unload`, and
`native_player_logged_in` and `native_player_logged_out`, which come in pairs however a player leaves, the server stopping included. Bundles that use them need `"hooks": @API:chunks_players@`.
